## Work log

<!-- Chronological, written as you go. What was actually done, why, what it cost.
     Reference commits and link to plans and notes. Prose beats a checklist here —

- Initialised the plan-and-diary convention (root-level layout: `plans/`, `work-diary/`,
  `scripts/work-diary.py`, block appended to `CLAUDE.md`). Repo had no commits yet.
- Surveyed `~/Coding_work/riverbanks-generator` (canon, drafts, plans, diaries, maps, network)
  to work out what riverbanks.lol should be. Key facts: the board footers carry the bare domain
  (no QR, no path), so `/` is everyone's landing page; comics live in private Supabase rows with
  no stored renders; the Sunda maps are gitignored there and rebuilt by `scripts/sunda-maps.py`.
- Proposed an in-world PLURIVERS-portal site (comics reader, Third Amendment signatures, river
  delegate badges, who's who, Sunda maps, the real ideas and credits). Yan's direction: the home
  page is an interactive map of Asia's river basins, Ice Age and present, with points opening
  comic pages. For now it sits behind a Taro "under construction, check back soon" animation.
  Not building yet; more materials are coming over the next few days. Captured in
  [the draft plan](../plans/2026-10-04_river-map-holding-page.plan.md).
- Added Claude's ideas to the plan as phase 3 (**Further ideas**). Each one says how it would
  hang off Yan's map, so the two sets add up rather than compete.
